jobs.title: Environmental Scientist
jobs.description:
**Company Description** **Work with Us. Change the World.**


At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations.


There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world.


We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.

 **Job Description** **AECOM** is seeking an entry\-level **Environmental Scientist** to join our Environmental Team in **Long Beach, California**. The successful candidate will support environmental investigation, monitoring, and remediation projects throughout Southern California while working alongside experienced scientists, geologists, and engineers. This role offers a mix of field and office responsibilities, including environmental data collection, site investigations, technical reporting, and project support.

***Key Responsibilities***

* Support environmental site investigations, monitoring programs, and remediation projects under the guidance of project managers and technical leads.
* Collect environmental samples including soil, groundwater, surface water, sediment, air, and soil vapor.
* Coordinate with and oversee subcontractors, including drilling, excavation, survey, and laboratory services.
* Maintain accurate field records, logs, chain\-of\-custody documentation, and photographic documentation.
* Manage, organize, and review environmental field and laboratory data.
* Assist in preparing technical reports, tables, figures, and other project deliverables.
* Support development of site conceptual models and interpretation of environmental data.
* Follow AECOM, client, and regulatory requirements while maintaining a strong safety culture.

  

**Qualifications** **Minimum Requirements:**

* Bachelor's degree in Environmental Science, Geology, Chemistry, Engineering, or a related field.
* Valid U.S. driver's license and ability to travel to project sites.
* Ability to travel up to 50% as project needs require.
* Ability to work safely in outdoor environments and varying site conditions.
* Must successfully pass a motor vehicle records review, substance screening, and medical surveillance program as conditions of employment.
* U.S. citizenship required due to project requirements.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience supporting environmental investigations or remediation projects.
* Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively in field and office environments, including internships, research projects, or academic fieldwork.
* Experience with environmental sampling techniques and field documentation practices.
* Experience supporting soil borings, monitoring well installation, or other subsurface investigations.
* Strong technical writing, data management, and Microsoft Office skills.
* Experience working with environmental contractors or field teams.
* Current 40\-hour HAZWOPER certification.
* Current First Aid/CPR training.
* Commitment to safe work practices and environmental stewardship.

  

**Additional Information**  

* Immediate opening available.
* Relocation assistance is not available for this position.
* Position requires a combination of field and office work.


At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. ***To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in\-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.***

 **About AECOM**


AECOM is proud to offer comprehensive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees. Depending on your employment status, AECOM benefits may include medical, dental, vision, life, AD\&D, disability benefits, paid time off, leaves of absences, voluntary benefits, perks, flexible work options, well\-being resources, employee assistance program, business travel insurance, service recognition awards, retirement savings plan, and employee stock purchase plan.


AECOM is the global infrastructure leader, committed to delivering a better world. As a trusted professional services firm powered by deep technical abilities, we solve our clients’ complex challenges in water, environment, energy, transportation and buildings. Our teams partner with public\- and private\-sector clients to create innovative, sustainable and resilient solutions throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm that had revenue of $16\.1 billion in fiscal year 2025\. Learn more at aecom.com.

**What makes AECOM a great place to work**


You will be part of a global team that champions your growth and career ambitions. Work on groundbreaking projects \- both in your local community and on a global scale \- that are transforming our industry and shaping the future. With cutting\-edge technology and a network of experts, you’ll have the resources to make a real impact. Our award\-winning training and development programs are designed to expand your technical expertise and leadership skills, helping you build the career you’ve always envisioned. Here, you’ll find a welcoming workplace built on respect, collaboration and community—where you have the freedom to grow in a world of opportunity.

jobs.title: Senior Sediment Remediation Specialist
jobs.description:
Responsibilities  

  

The Senior Sediment Remediation Specialist will lead complex environmental investigations and the design of cleanup strategies for contaminated sediment sites in riverine, lacustrine, estuarine, and marine environments. This senior role requires a seasoned professional to provide technical, managerial, regulatory, and business development support to LimnoTech’s existing contaminated sediments practice. Typical job responsibilities include the following, depending on individual ability, skills, and experience:  

* Leading and overseeing technical work for the full lifecycle of sediment projects, which may include developing site characterization, remedial investigation (RI), and feasibility study (FS) plans; overseeing multi\-media sampling programs (sediment, water, biota, etc.); data interpretation (geostatistics, fingerprinting, etc.); numerical modeling (hydrodynamic, contaminant fate and transport, etc.); developing conceptual site models; evaluating and implementing remedial alternatives (dredging, capping, MNR, etc.); remedial cost estimating; and translating complex scientific findings into high quality technical written/verbal deliverables. Litigation support and expert witness experience is desirable.
* Managing projects through the full project management life cycle, including developing scopes of work, managing budgets, leading and mentoring project teams, coordinating with multi\-disciplinary teams of scientist, engineers, regulators, and responsible parties, delivering high quality deliverables on time and on budget, and client management.
* Providing regulatory expertise on contaminated sediment projects (e.g.: CERCLA, RCRA, or local state programs), which may include agency negotiations.
* Leading and participating in marketing and business development activities, which may include tracking and pursuing relevant requests for proposals, developing marketing documents (quals packages, project profiles, web articles, etc.), cultivating and nurturing client and partner relationships, and actively participating at relevant conferences (e.g.: Battelle).
  

  

Qualifications  

  

The ideal candidate will possess a minimum of a Bachelor of Science degree in Civil or Environmental Engineering, Geology, Environmental Science, or a closely related physical science discipline with 10 or more years of experience in the field. A Master’s degree or Ph.D. is strongly preferred, as the role demands a deep understanding of complex contaminant transport, sediment geochronology, and geochemical partitioning.  

* For engineering applicants, an active Professional Engineer (PE) license is expected; for scientists, a Professional Geologist (PG) or related credentials would be highly valued, demonstrating a commitment to professional standards and the ability to seal technical documents.
* In addition to formal academic credentials, specialized training in hydrodynamic modeling or statistical data analysis is a significant advantage.
* Candidates must also have completed the 40\-hour OSHA HAZWOPER certification with current annual refreshers, ensuring they are qualified to oversee field activities at hazardous waste sites.
* Continuous education through participation in industry organizations, such as the Battelle Sediment Conference or ITRC technical teams, is encouraged to ensure the firm remains at the forefront of emerging remediation technologies and evolving regulatory frameworks.
* A demonstrated interest or experience in urban waterfront restoration, engineering with nature, or nature\-based solutions is a plus.
* Must be legally able to work in the U.S. for any employer (proper documentation is required).
  

  

Compensation  

  

Individual achievement is rewarded through a unique merit review process based on recommendations from colleagues at all levels of the company, plus positive feedback from clients. This system drives pay increases and opportunities for increased project and corporate responsibility. We track individual progress annually to ensure competitiveness within our industry and identify opportunities for targeted professional development. The salary for this position will be determined based on the candidate’s years and type of experience, degrees earned, office location, and fit with job requirements, and is expected to range between $110,000 and $200,000 annually.  

  

Our company culture focuses on giving our people opportunities to improve and grow through training, conferences, workshops, seminars, and participation in professional organizations. We also favor more personal, self\-directed career planning over traditional performance evaluations. We encourage a mix of mentoring and proactive self\-management so individuals can explore and create work opportunities that further their careers.
